definition: per run a fresh app on an empty trusted project with one run configuration whose [debug] launches a target that sleeps (exit: 1 s, ends by itself; stop: 60 s, the scenario stops the session after 4 s) under the adapter set by `[dap.<id>] path`; the app's descendants are polled every 25 ms; pass = no descendant before `debug_starting`, and every descendant that appeared after it is gone ≤ 2000 ms after `debug_ended` (exit: when the webview saw the session end; stop: when it called stop); adapters ["codelldb", "js-debug", "debugpy"], endings ["exit", "stop"], 3 runs each
